indicators.note: spoiling the word risk wrecks its order, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A warning that some Chinese liqueur might go off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spoiling' rearranges RISK into KIRS; CH follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Kirsch is a clear cherry brandy, a kind of spirit or liqueur.

clue.text: Professional killer liquidated characters in cinema

indicators.note: liquidated characters means the letters of the word are dissolved and recast

explanation.surface: A hitman who has wiped out the people in a film.
explanation.walkthrough: 'liquidated' rearranges CINEMA; 'characters in' are linking words.
explanation.definitionFit: Iceman is slang for a hired assassin, a contract killer.

parts.note: a spell is a period of time
to bind is to tie fast or secure

explanation.surface: A moment to lock up the doorway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entrance' is the verb (to en-TRANCE), not the doorway.
explanation.definitionFit: To spellbind someone is to hold them in a trance, to enthral.

parts.note: to hear of something is to find it out

indicators.note: generated means produced, so the letters of cheat are recast

explanation.surface: Discovering a cheating partner caused great pain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'generated' rearranges CHEAT into TACHE.
explanation.definitionFit: Heartache is deep emotional distress or grief.

parts.note: to hand something over is to offer it
divers in its old sense means various or several, as does some

explanation.surface: A gift for scuba divers that turns out to be a lavish find.
explanation.walkthrough: 'divers' is the archaic adjective meaning several, not people who swim underwater; 'find' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A handsome sum or gift is a large, liberal one.

parts.note: to till soil is to work it, as with a hoe
down means fallen to the ground

explanation.surface: A dance until someone ends up on the floor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'till' looks like 'until' but is the farming verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoedown is a lively American country dance.

indicators.note: bad suggests the word thing is spoiled, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A moral claim that darkness is evil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' rearranges THING; 'is a' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Night is the dark period between sunset and sunrise.

indicators.note: in places the first item inside the second

parts.note: sour means unpleasant or distasteful
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: Someone caught up in an unpleasant political purge.
explanation.definitionFit: To scour is to clean out or flush thoroughly, as a purge does.

clue.text: Aircraft drop explosives initially in attack

parts.note: a MiG is a Russian fighter aircraft
to rain is to drop or fall from the sky

indicators.note: initially means take only the opening letter of explosives

explanation.surface: Warplanes dropping bombs in a raid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A migraine attack is a bout of severe headache.

clue.text: Bishop always has time for a drink

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
ever means always, as in ever hopeful
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: A clergyman who always finds the time to have a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Any liquid for drinking, from tea to wine, is a beverage.

indicators.note: encircles tells us the first word's synonym goes around the second's abbreviation

parts.note: to wolf food is to gorge on it

explanation.surface: A wolf surrounding England's patron saint, as in a dragon legend gone wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wolf' looks like the animal but is the verb meaning eat greedily.
explanation.definitionFit: St George is the patron saint of England.

indicators.note: keeps means holds within, so one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a paddy is a fit of temper, as is a pet, a sulk
all means everyone

explanation.surface: An angry tantrum while the whole family is in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Paddy' looks like an Irishman but is a British word for a tantrum; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A pallet is a straw mattress or rough makeshift bed.

parts.note: when a secret is out it has been revealed
a break is a pause or lull

explanation.surface: News revealed that there was a quiet spell in a spreading disease.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden spread of disease is an outbreak, near enough an epidemic.

parts.note: B, the second grade, means second-rate
US means American

explanation.surface: A poor-quality American car.
explanation.definitionFit: A bus is a large road vehicle carrying passengers.

clue.text: Brilliant being of royal Peruvian lineage

parts.note: the Inca rulers were Peruvian royalty, so Incan is their adjective
descent means ancestry or lineage

explanation.surface: Someone shines because they come from the old Peruvian royal line.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'being of royal Peruvian lineage' as 'of Incan descent'; 'being of' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Glowing with heat or shining brightly is the literal sense; figuratively it means dazzling.

indicators.note: in places the first pieces inside the adjective

parts.note: elusive means hard to pin down, baffling
X is the algebraic unknown
C stands for Conservative, the party of the Tories

explanation.surface: A mysterious Conservative caught up in a bewildering scandal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'expose' is the noun exposé, a revealing story.
explanation.definitionFit: A newspaper exclusive is a scoop, often a revelation of scandal.

clue.text: Blast shy Indian opener over wicket

parts.note: to shy a ball is to throw or cast it

indicators.note: opener means just the first letter of the word Indian

parts.note: a wicket is a small gate

explanation.surface: Criticising a timid Indian opening batsman for losing his wicket.
explanation.walkthrough: The cricket picture misleads: 'shy' is the verb throw, 'wicket' a small gate; 'over' is a link putting the pieces in order.
explanation.definitionFit: To blast someone is to criticise them harshly, to castigate.

parts.note: liter is the American spelling of litre, a unit of volume
devoured means ate

explanation.surface: A scholarly American has eaten up a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'volume' looks like a book but is a unit of capacity.
explanation.definitionFit: A literate person is educated and widely read.

parts.note: to tinker with something is to fiddle with it
to stick something, in British slang, is to put up with it

explanation.surface: A mender of pots puts up with offal for dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tinker' looks like the travelling mender and 'tripe' like offal; both serve other senses.
explanation.definitionFit: Tripe means nonsense, and fiddlesticks is an exclamation of nonsense.

parts.note: L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
OT is the Old Testament, a set of books

explanation.surface: A big library of books.
explanation.definitionFit: A lot is a set of items, as at an auction.

indicators.note: foolishly suggests the word lost is treated carelessly and jumbled

parts.note: to toy with something is to play with it

explanation.surface: An author stupidly mislaid a script.
explanation.walkthrough: 'foolishly' rearranges LOST into TOLS.
explanation.definitionFit: Leo Tolstoy was the Russian novelist of War and Peace.

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Hunting for silver with some vigour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To forage is to rummage or hunt about for food or supplies.

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one word goes around the other

parts.note: real feelings are sincere ones
a butt is the victim of a joke; the 's is a link

explanation.surface: An honest person defending a victim against an accusation.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebuttal is a contradiction or refutation of a claim.

parts.note: the UN is the body sending peacekeepers
a cut is a share or portion

explanation.surface: A peacekeeper's share of the funds is paid in full.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An uncut film or text is whole and unabridged.

clue.text: Evil dwarf makes Trojan leader grumble

indicators.note: leader asks for only the first letter of Trojan

parts.note: thunder grumbles or rolls, so roll means grumble

explanation.surface: A nasty little creature makes the commander of Troy complain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'makes' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: In Scandinavian folklore a troll is a malevolent dwarf or giant.

clue.text: Harmony old Bob found in wedlock

indicators.note: found in means placed inside, so one piece goes within another

parts.note: marriage is a union
bob was slang for a shilling, abbreviated S in pre-decimal British money

explanation.surface: Peace in a marriage once a man called Bob joins it.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'bob' was a British shilling before 1971, written s.
explanation.definitionFit: Singing in unison is in accord; figuratively it means agreement.

indicators.note: developed suggests the letters of a cough are worked into a new form

explanation.surface: A ranch hand came down with a cough.
explanation.walkthrough: 'developed' rearranges A COUGH.
explanation.definitionFit: A gaucho is a cattle herder of the South American pampas.

parts.note: trim means neat and smart
to run a machine is to operate it

explanation.surface: A stylish American sailed a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A trimaran is a sailing vessel with three hulls.

parts.note: men means people
a tally is a count

explanation.surface: Folk doing sums without paper or calculator.
explanation.definitionFit: Done mentally means done in the mind, without writing.

clue.text: A number in the Spanish flat

parts.note: el is the Spanish masculine definite article
even means flat or level

explanation.surface: A house number in a Spanish apartment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flat' looks like an apartment but means level; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Eleven is the number after ten.
